full_judgment:
Mainur Reza Choudhury, J: This petition for leave to appeal by the petitioner is directed against the judgment and order passed by the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 2391 of 1993 discharging the Rule and upholding the judgment and decree passed by Subordinate Judge, 4th Court, Dhaka in Title Appeal No. 259 of 1989 reversing the judgment and decree of the Assistant Judge, 4th Court, Dhaka, in Title Suit No. 318 of 1986. 

 2. The plaintiff petitioner was dismissed from service by the respondent defendants after departmental proceedings against him. Being aggrieved he filed the above suit for declarations that he had been wrongly dismissed and for a further declaration that he was still in service. His contention was that during the pendency of criminal proceeding the respondent defendant No. 1 started departmental proceeding against him without giving any opportunity to defend himself. The trial court decreed the suit. The appellate court allowed the appeal and dismissed the suit against which the plaintiff petitioner moved the High Court Division in revision. The judgment of the appellate court was assailed on the ground that he was found guilty by the Inquiry Officer although no report of the inquiry officer was furnished along with second show cause notice and so he could not reply effectively to the second show cause notice.
